subject: general
question:
Which contemporary painter made a series of paintings on Mahatma Gandhi?

A. Amrita Shergill

B. Ram Kinkar

C. M.F. Hussain

D. Atul Dodiya
solution:
Option **2** is correct.

__
 
• **Atul Dodiya**__ made a series of paintings on **Mahatma Gandhi**. 
 
• He is considered one of the finest Indian artists of the generation.
 
• He is known for his Hyper-realist depictions of middle-class Indian life, Series of watercolor paintings depicting marginalized and poor sections of society, for example, a plumber, a scribe, or a painter, etc.
 
• In 1991, he reconstructed images from a forgotten biography of Mahatma Gandhi. He used watercolors to paint numerous historic events of Gandhi's life.
 
• He also installed "Broken Branches" made in 2002 inspired by the philosophy of Mahatma Gandhi in Venice Biennale 2019 (art exhibition).
